confirmed.statement: S1-O1 satisfies criterion 3: three independent design experts scored participants’ creative works using CSDS; the creative-performance score is not a participant self-report.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5, section 3.2.3 Research procedure; p. 6, section 3.3.1 Creative performance test.

confirmed.statement: The overall_creativity and expert_raters codes are supported: the 30-item CSDS assesses product creativity across Relevance and Effectiveness, Novelty, Elegance, and Genesis, with item ratings from 1 to 5, weighted-average dimension scores, and a possible creative-performance score of 150.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 5-6, section 3.3.1; creativity-codebook.md, section 6, Construct and Measure.

confirmed.statement: AI was available during production of the scored output: participants used ChatGPT for concept ideation and Stable Diffusion for design images before post-processing, supporting ai_available_when_produced=yes and question=with_ai.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 6, section 3.4.2; p. 5, section 3.2.3 and Figure 1; creativity-codebook.md, section 1.

confirmed.statement: The immediate timing is supported by one three-hour design session followed by evaluation of its submitted works; the paper reports no separate creative output produced after AI removal.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5, section 3.2.3 and Figure 1; p. 6, section 3.4.1; p. 13, section 6 Limitation and further research.

confirmed.statement: The analysis unit is participant: Figure 4 presents scores for each participant, and Table 1 counts 32 participants per arm. Leaving n_units null is consistent with the codebook reserving that field for non-person observations.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 8, section 3.7 and Table 1; p. 9, Figure 4; creativity-codebook.md, sections 6-7.

confirmed.statement: The ai_vs_active comparison and treatment_higher direction are supported: the control used internet research and conventional design software without AIGC, and its mean creative-performance score was lower.

confirmed.statement: Only aggregate CSDS creative performance has a separately reported creative-output comparison. The four dimensions have no separate estimates; EEG concentration and relaxation measure physiological states, while Figures 4-5 display the existing scores and their relationships.

summary: No outcome coding error was found: expert-rated CSDS scores, AI availability, question, construct, participant unit, and reported statistics are supported by the PDF.
